image_description: A close-up shot of a slender, worm-like snake coiled among green grass blades. The snake has a glossy, iridescent body with purple and green hues reflecting light, rather than the expected pinkish-brown. The scales appear smooth and regular. The head is not clearly visible, blending into the coils and grass. There is gibberish text at the bottom of the image.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a line of nonsensical, garbled white characters at the very bottom, resembling corrupted OCR or AI-generated text artifacts. This is a severe structural artifact indicating synthetic origin.

The scales exhibit an unnatural rainbow iridescence (purple/green/blue) that is overly saturated and metallic compared to the typical glossy but naturally colored scales of a thunder snake. This suggests a texture generation error or over-stylization.
Some grass blades intersect with the snake in a physically ambiguous way, with slight blurring or 'melting' at the contact points, lacking sharp occlusion boundaries.
